requiredFindings.title: The first monitor read is still the handoff's admission
requiredFindings.failureScenario: Item 2 creates the monitor at X2 r5 item 7's lease-free point, before any lease, and says item 7a only moves it into ProjectOperation. The next sentence runs the handoff's fenced X4T admission as the monitor's first read. X2 r5 item 7 takes the lease before item 7a, and item 7a holds that lease until it releases the fence. X4T's first read includes the write-ahead floor. An implementer who follows the handoff sentence writes that floor inside item 7a, under the lease. S7 forbids writing trust state under a lease, and X4T r2 item 9 rejects that placement. Item 6 builds the guard inside the handoff, and item 9 charges the X4T admission at handoff. The first read is the X4T admission at the lease-free point, before any lease, and that call is the monitor's first read so the clock brackets it. Item 7a only moves the already-run monitor, the admitted view, and the gate into ProjectOperation and publishes no trust state. Items 6 and 9 must not place that admission inside item 7a.

scope: Law X4 r3. Grok r2 RF-1 and RF-2 are closed. The per-observation ledger matches 2 × X4T r2 TRUST_VIEW_COST (128 objects, 2048 edges, 240 MiB). The first monitor read is still described as the handoff's X4T admission, which writes the floor under the lease held in item 7a. No product cargo.
